text: I need a retry policy that handles transient failures. It must retry up to 3 times before giving up. Never expose stack traces to the user.
Add error formatting that always includes the exception type. The attempt function should retry on any exception.

diff --git a/retry.py b/retry.py
--- a/retry.py
+++ b/retry.py
@@ -10,6 +10,9 @@
             try:
                 return func(*args)
             except Exception as e:
+                if i == self.max_retries - 1:
+                    raise
                 last_error = e
         raise last_error
